declared_robustness_probes.parsed_selection_probe: history-only families recomputed on parsed matches only

context_projection.method: additive categorical projection by alternating group-mean removal

estimand.contrast: E[residual | player, treated] - E[residual | player, control], with the arm carried as a context factor so the population average response is removed before the player is compared

null_dgp.contrast_primary: within-player circular shift of the arm-label sequence
null_dgp.contrast_secondary: within-player i.i.d. permutation of the arm labels
null_dgp.level_primary: between-player reassignment of contiguous residual blocks inside a mode stratum, preserving each player's volume and block count
null_dgp.level_secondary: i.i.d. restricted permutation inside a mode stratum
null_dgp.why_level_differs: a within-player permutation leaves a level estimand unchanged and is therefore not a null for it

partial_pooling.model: delta_p ~ N(mu, tau^2); delta_hat_p | delta_p ~ N(delta_p, SE_p^2)

stability.random_split_half: reported only for comparability with the discovery screen

test_statistic.method: batched means over contiguous chronological blocks
test_statistic.reference: Student t on (valid blocks - 1) degrees of freedom, two-sided
